caption: The drawing depicts a composition featuring a brown rectangular building with a red gabled roof and multiple arched blue windows, set against a plain, light-colored background. To the left of the building, there are two green trees behind a brown cart pulled by a tan horse, which is being led by a figure wearing a hat and blue clothing. Next to the cart stand two human figures dressed in long garments, one in blue and the other in a light color. To their left are two animals resembling horses, and below them is a small brown pig. In front of the building and extending along its length are two white birds with orange beaks. On the far right side, aligned with the base of the building, there is a long narrow boat or barge, inside which a seated figure wearing red clothing is visible.
title: Noah's Ark with Animals
